title: Bava Batra 7a (2)

chapters.title: Property Division and the Dispute Over the Wall
chapters.about: two brothers dividing an estate, Asplida, Tarbisa, building a wall, blocking light

chapters.title: Comparing the Wall Dispute to the Vineyard Beraita
chapters.about: Ravina questioning Rav Ashe, vineyard and wheat field, six amot of usage rights

chapters.title: Rashi's Explanation on Window Rights and Three Years
chapters.about: Hazakhat halonot, three years of usage, Rashi's approach to the division

chapters.title: Ritva's Question and Counterclaims
chapters.about: Hezek ri'ah, building on one's own property, common practice in gardens

chapters.title: Tosafot and the Aruch's Definition of Asplida
chapters.about: Tosafot, Aruch, cave definition, identifying questions on Rashi

summary: Rabbi Harari examines a Gemara discussion in Masekhet Baba Batra concerning property divisions between brothers or partners, focusing on a dispute where one built a wall that blocked light from another's space. He compares this scenario with the rules of usage rights applied to a vineyard and a wheat field, and reviews the commentaries of Rashi and Tosafot.
questions: What rights does a person have to light and air after a property is divided?
How does the division of a vineyard differ from the division of a mansion or garden area regarding usage rights?
What is the role of a three-year Hazakah in window space and light access?
How do Rashi and the Aruch differ in their understanding of the term Asplida?
